name: container-lifecycle-management
description: Portable Docker Compose maintenance, repeatable installation and bounded clean rebuild workflows with explicit state and source gates.

interface.shortDescription: Audit, deploy, update, rebuild and recover Docker Compose applications
defaultPrompt: Audit my Compose server without changing its state.
Plan available container updates and tell me which are safe.
Rebuild my named Docker application cleanly, discard only approved caches/models, preserve personal data, and verify reproducible sources and future update readiness.
Update eligible AUTO_SAFE services under the current project's maintenance policy while preserving data.

Deploy the latest approved release of my project-managed application, verify persistent state and, if optional project-memory tooling is available and authorized, checkpoint confirmed deployment facts; otherwise report pending sync.
interface.longDescription: Audit and plan Docker maintenance; guide first installs, controlled clean rebuilds of existing apps and bounded project/repository deployments. Protect user state, preserve canonical Compose/build sources, and gate owner access and functional acceptance. Production mutations remain agent-operated, not a bundled CLI executor.
